_model: Scored discovery, mirroring UC1/branch scoring: every candidate scored on normalized 0-1 layers, combined by normalized weights, ranked. No per-source special-casing.

origin.name: __ORIGIN_NAME__
origin._note: set to YOUR locality centre in config

community._venue_note: No single venue (e.g. one bar) may take more than 2 community slots — prevents 'four nights at The Finch' domination. Added 2026-09-09.

rel_tambrahm._dated_events_note: Dated flyer events (e.g. Bhajan Samaj Sama Veda Upakarma) carry event_time -> event-imminence (announce + reminder near the date). Livestreams have only post_time -> post-time recency, unchanged. Fixes the 2026-09-09 Sama Veda Upakarma miss.

rel_jain._touchpoints: Appears TWICE: (1) announcement — first discovery; (2) reminder — the morning the event's ACTIONABLE deadline (arrival/registration close, else start) is within 24h. Anchoring on the deadline, not a fixed 48h-before-start, so a residential shibir surfaces on its arrival day, not a day early. Deduped otherwise. (Fixed 2026-09-07.)

rel_vaishnav._touchpoints: Appears TWICE: (1) announcement — first discovery; (2) reminder — the morning the event's ACTIONABLE deadline (arrival/registration close, else start) is within 24h. Anchoring on the deadline, not a fixed 48h-before-start, so a residential shibir surfaces on its arrival day, not a day early. Deduped otherwise. (Fixed 2026-09-07.)

alerts._desc: weather red/orange alerts, heavy-rain/flooding warnings, safety advisories

fun_events._desc: workshops, cultural shows, fun/community activities (BookMyShow, community halls)

elder_health._desc: free/subsidised medical clinics, health & eye camps, check-ups for senior citizens

prahaar.note: Marathi daily (Prahaar) — real newsroom, via Codex/web

saamana.note: Marathi daily (Shiv Sena) — corroborate political items

imd.note: official — India Meteorological Dept, Mumbai bulletins

weights._note: Raw weights; the scorer normalizes them to sum=1 before combining. Redundancy checked: proximity and sector_relevance are near-independent; recency is orthogonal to both.

proximity._desc: 1.0 at 0km, linear to 0.0 at 6km; beyond 6km => score 0 (hard gate).

recency._desc: 1.0 at post/event time, linear to 0.0 at the sector's recency_window_h. For imminent sectors, measured from the EVENT start (negative age = upcoming) not post time. HARD news-freshness cap: a POST_TIME item on the 'news' signal_type is gated if older than news_post_max_age_h (24h), even if its sector's window is longer (e.g. the 48h imminent sectors transport/civic/traffic/alerts/utilities) — that 48h is only for upcoming events via event_time. PAST-EVENT GATE: for imminent event_time items, once the event has STARTED (positive age) it stays fresh only imminent_past_grace_h (6h), then gates — mirrors the 24h post cap so a past 'happening today' event can't linger up to 48h. Upcoming (negative age) events keep the full window/horizon. announce_once (multi-day festivals, reminders) is unaffected.

hard_gates._note: A candidate scoring 0 on any hard gate is dropped before ranking, regardless of other layers.
hard_gates.timestamp_verified: publish/update or event time must be confirmed from the source, not a search snippet
hard_gates.location_verified: event must resolve inside 6km; a locality name merely appearing is not enough
hard_gates.not_duplicate: deduped on event+location+entities; multi-day events announced once (keyed in sent_stories)

discovery._model: HYBRID: poll feeds where they exist (cheap, precise); sweep-search only where no feed exists (fallback). Never keyword-sweep a community that already has a feed.

dedup._model: Fingerprint on the SPECIFIC subject of THIS bullet, not the umbrella event it occurred at. Scope by signal_type so a bright/community item never collides with a news item.
dedup.fingerprint: <sector>|<specific-subject-slug>|<date>  — sector prefix keeps signal_types from colliding
rules: A distinct positive/human-interest sub-story of an already-sent event is NOT a duplicate. An award given AT the Dahi Handi is its own story (the honorees), separate from the Dahi Handi bullet.
Dedup a candidate only against prior rows of the SAME signal_type. A bright-spot checks only bright-spot history; news checks news.
True duplicates (same subject, same facts, another outlet) still collapse to one, keeping the strongest source.
A previously-sent story returns only on a material NEW development.
dedup._fixed: 2026-09-07: was collapsing positive sub-stories into the parent event, starving the bright slot.

youtube_title_filter._why: 2026-09-07: the Murugan temple posts a generic 'SRI SUBRAMANIA SAMAJ is live' daily with no program detail — a content-free bullet every day. Suppress it.
youtube_title_filter.rule: Emit a religious YouTube item ONLY if its title NAMES a program/festival. Drop generic livestreams whose title matches (case-insensitive) 'is live', 'live now', 'live stream', or is just the channel name.
youtube_title_filter.keep_example: Janmashtami Mahotsav 2026 | Bhajans by Guru Paduka Group  (Shankaralayam — titled -> keep)
youtube_title_filter.drop_example: SRI SUBRAMANIA SAMAJ is live  (Murugan — generic -> drop)
youtube_title_filter.consequence: Murugan will usually not appear; it surfaces only when a stream is titled (e.g. a Skanda Sashti / Nataraja Aradhana special). Honest: a daily untitled prayer stream is not news.
